company_info.company_description: "The difference with AG Solar is that our business began with two local qualified electricians, Trent and Daniel, having a passion for renewable energy. They wanted people to receive reliable information without sales tactics in an ever-changing space, which has now become essential for everyone with a home or business.The need for this honest information, quality products and high level of customer service in their local area led them to teaming up to form AG Solar.In renewable energy, there is consistently new technology and research so we think it is important to be passionate about the industry and always learning new information for our customers. We want to be able to inform our customers about any needs they may have including electric vehicles/charging and solar battery storage. We think if we stay at the forefront of the industry our customers will reap the rewards and won’t be supplied with outdated information and products.AG Solar value customer service and will ensure the process is straightforward, which begins with directly speaking to either Trent, Daniel or trained in-house employees. You will also have one of our four electrical in-house teams do your installation, not just any contractor that arrives. With over 20 years combined solar experience, we can design and install the perfect system for your individual requirements."

reviews.review_description: Sales team friendly and helpful.Installer team were polite and professional.Company organised everything from start to finish..

Responsive to requests as we went through several iterations to arrive at the final number and arrangement of panels, also changed from initially recommended options to Sungrow inverter and battery to save space and supply 3 phase to our house.Installation was by in-house AG Solar electricians, no sub contractors involved was a key reason for selecting them.Installation was a day and a half, panels installed in one day, moved TV antenna to accommodate panels. Handled all correspondence with our energy supplier.Responsive to issue with system operation with a service call the day after installation.All round very professional and courteous.

Ag Solar were very professional to work with. Quick informative quote, discount in place for the month of install, system installed and working within 2 weeks of quoting. No issues on installation day - (not one tile cracked). Very happy with the total experience.
They organised the whole process. Excellent follow up and support. Answered all instantly.

Trent was extremely helpful and answered all my questions over email and phone. He was knowledgable and concise, and never pushed me to make a purchase. I was able to do my research and arrive at AG Solar knowing that they represented the best choice for me.There was an expected 2-3 month waiting period over the Christmas period, however, they got the job done within a couple of weeks, allowing me to catch the summer sun as my first season with solar, which was a great feeling.The invoice that I received was probably the best invoice I've ever seen, in any industry. It was a sleek, information booklet with a few facts about how much my proposed solar unit would cost and what it would save.The installation was performed by subcontractors, who were punctual, tidy, efficient and friendly. I would happily deal with them again.There was an installation issue where a panel was seen to eclipse the roofline on a particular angle, that was going to cause a shading issue on the panels below it on the other roof angle. I spoke with Trent from AG Solar, who in turn spoke with the subcontractors, and within 10 minutes organised for the subcontractors to come back the very next day to rectify the issue. They were extremely friendly and happy to help the following day, and it only took them about 20 minutes to adjust. No issue here, it was very well handled.Post-installation I received all the appropriate documents from AG Solar for me to action with my energy company, and that more or less was that. Terrific experience overall, which is especially great and validating as it was a journey to do all the research and build the confidence to shell out over 7k on a solar system.Tell Trent I'll be back when I need a battery ;)My system is a 6.65kW system with a 5kW inverter. I purchased an additional Solar Analytics device which added $400 to my bill, but I figure it'll be worth the investment for what value it brings. Total cost was $7,700.
AG Solar very helpful, whole process from original contact to final installation was smooth with no issues.

We highly recommend AG Solar. From quoting to installation & post install follow up, this company is professional, well organised and has great communication. We were treated with respect & courtesy. A very good experience.

Fantastic experience from a truly professional team of tradesmen. Arrived on time at 7am.  Polite and respectful. All rubbish cleared up and taken away. Amazing. Highly recommend.  Thanks so much guys.

Absolutely cannot fault the service we received from AG Solar. From start to finish, their customer service was impeccable. They took the time to explain every step of the process in detail, ensuring we felt confident and informed throughout. The team was professional, courteous, and always available to speedily answer any questions we had. The installation was smooth and efficient, and we are so happy with the output of our system. Highly recommend them for anyone considering solar!

This is the third time I have used AG Solar. The whole process is just so well run. Once again, everything worked like clockwork. The follow-up was comprehensive. Excellent communications. Highly recommended.
Quote for 10KW solar and Tesla Powerwall 3 battery was competitive and communication excellent through the process. On the day the team were great - friendly, professional and did a great job

We have had  two lots of solar panels installed by AG solar, and on both occasions the quotation, installation and after sales service has been excellent and seamless.Highly recommended.Professional team at all levels

Great pre-purchase support and so easy to adapt for future expansion. Really personable installation team as well. Everything went like clockwork with post-install followup and clarification around battery covers. Definitely recommend.

The quoting process was very thorough, prompt and professional. Aaron was an excellent contact. The installation went smoothly and the fitout was extremely neat and precise.  Overall and excellent job by the team.
AG Solar were great to deal with, providing several quotes and options, patiently answering our many questions. Installation was seamless and quick.

Adam was very prompt in discussing our needs and providing quotes, including for an Enphase battery that I requested but did not end up buying because the Tesla, although expensive, was a cheaper and better option for our needs. The installation was prompt and very professional. The battery immediately started working well with our 5.12kW solar system and we have used no power from the grid since that day.  I did have initial trouble getting the app to work on my iPhone to register the battery until I contacted Tesla and they registered it remotely. Ben, AG Solar's technical person, was off sick that week but when he returned he did offer to come out and help, however Tesla had sorted it out by then. We are very happy.

We chose to get a Powerwall 2 installed by AG Solar. The Powerwall 2 was discounted and had very good reviews and suited our needs. The installation was quick and efficient and the system works well. AG were very helpful in sorting out a minor glitch in getting data collection working.

I've requested 3 quites for a second Tesla PW2 through Solarquotes as I had a gut feel my previous PW2 installer (also great experience a year ago) hasn't adjusted to the market prices.I've ended up speaking with Adam F. as my second respondent and I was impressed from get go. It was the most efficient andpleasant sales call I've ever experienced. All sorted and locked in for a couple of days ahead from memory.Within half an hour or so my installation was even locked in for the following day.As scheduled, a day after the sales call a team of inhouse installers arrived, completed the installation and after a brief handover left our place. All that remained was a nicely installed second PW2. Not a gram of any extras...Very happy with the entire process from call to installation.

AG Solar came out and gave a quote, actually a couple of quotes based on different configuration options. Once we decided what we wanted we paid the deposit (10%) and an installation date was arranged. Rhys was very easy to deal with, he was polite, friendly and professional.The AG Solar guys showed up around 7am as planned and got to work straight away. Jye, our installer couldn't have been nicer, or more professional. We had an initial discussion about placement of the battery and the gateway and there were progress updates as the installation progressed. We also had a new heat pump installed as part of the installation. AG Solar had their own plumber to do the installation and coordinate with the electrical works. The system was up and running after 5-6 hours and has been faultlessly since. I was assisted with downloading the Tesla app and shown how to pair it with the Tesla Powerwall 3 battery and how to monitor the operation of the panels and battery.All the team were very polite and friendly and did a great job. All the work was neat and they left the site clean and took all the rubbish with them and took the old water heating system away.

All went well. From the quotation (and advice) to installation. Job required the removal of existing two inverters and connecting the existing PV panels to a new Powerwall 3. In addition another 2.25kW PV panels were added.Installers were punctual and polite; cleaning up before leaving.Unfortunately, the three "SolarQuotes" recommended installers were found wanting.
Sale and quoting - excellent. Amber did not try to rush us and was very patient answering our pre-sales question.Could not fault the installation.Excellent customer service.
Everything above was taken care of. Good service delivered in a friendly manner
The install was punctual and was left in a clean manner.

The sales person was very helpful in adapting the quote for the best system for us. Installation was good, though we were surprised when the scaffolding company turned up very early the day before without warning. The inverter app is not straight forward and we will need more help with it. I trust that they will provide it!

I've been umming and ahhing about solar for a few years and decided to get more information. I used Solar Quotes to get three quotes from certified installers in my area and landed on AG Solar.I dealt with Rhys at AG Solar. He was patient with my questions and provided a good line of communication from quote to deposit.Before even pulling the trigger, they worked within my budget and made excellent product recommendations (which I separately verified) and I was so happy with the feedback.Once the deposit was paid, my installation was booked within the week. The installers were great and professional. They took great care of the installation and ensured it was clean (no visible conduit, cabling, or labelling). I'll definitely recommend their services to friends and family and use them again.Regarding the system's performance, I'm only one day into using it, so it's too soon to tell, but it's already outperforming my expectations.

We recently had a fantastic experience working with AG Solar to install a solar panel system on our home, and we couldn’t be happier with the experience! From start to finish, the entire process was smooth, professional, and incredibly efficient.The team at AG Solar provided exceptional customer service. They were responsive, knowledgeable, and took the time to answer all of our questions. The initial consultation was thorough, and they provided a clear explanation of how solar panels work, the installation process, and the best system for our home and requirements.The installation process was seamless. The crew arrived on time, were courteous, and worked diligently to ensure everything was installed correctly. The attention to detail was impressive, and they left everything clean and tidy. The solar panels themselves are high-quality and have been performing exceptionally well. We've already noticed a decrease in our energy bills.After the installation, we connected AG Solar as there was a an issue with the connection of the solar panels to our app. They solved the problem quickly, and followed up to ensure everything was running smoothly and offered additional support if needed.Overall, I highly recommend AG Solar to anyone considering making the switch to solar energy. My parents and parents in-law have also since had solar panel systems installed by AG Solar following our positive experience. Thanks Team!

AG Solar was fantastic to deal with. Trent initially provided a quote including a free cover for the Fronius inverter. They installed as promised on the date as had to co-ordinate with the roof painter. Tidy install and cleaned up after. The handled all the paperwork and organised the grid connection.Jye, Lily and Amy were also very responsive before, during and after the whole process. Thank you team!Highly recommend AG Solar as they use quality products.

I tried many installers for a quote. A G Solar gave a simple complete quote covering my needs after a call to confirm what was required. Install date was decided and old system removed and replaced in the same day. Installers all polite and happy to explain what they were doing.by the end of the day all was installed and functioning. With in next 2 days web access was running and a week later meters were being updated. All a simple and positive experience.

THE INSTALLATION START WAS ON TIME AS PROMISED..THE INSTALLERS WERE VERY KNOWLEDGEABLE AND CARING ,EFFICIENT AND CLEANED UP WELL DURING AND AT THE END OF THERE WORK.THE COMPANY MANAGED ALL ASPECTS OF CONNECTION TO THE GEID FOR US AND HELPED WITH AN AFTERMARKET ON SITE FOLLOW UP TO ENSURE OUR UNDERSTANDING AND ENSURE THERE WERE NO ISSUES .

We chose AG Solar after an extensive search, with the main deciding factors being panel and inverter quality and performance, and long warranties for these and the installation. Another aspect we liked was that they directly employ all their staff rather than contractors, which is rather unusual.The quoting process was simple, fast, and accurate, resulting in panel placement optimised for our complex roofs. There were no hidden costs, fees, or charges, and they arranged the government rebates seamlessly.Even though they are located about 50km away, they arranged two fast and efficient installations, the first being 26 panels, the second an additional 16.Throughout all of our interactions all their people have been polite, knowledgeable and flexible, with perhaps the most pleasing being reliability. They always arrived when promised, and always completed the work as requested and planned.Each installation concluded with grid connection, thorough testing and familiarisation and handover to us, demonstrating the various features of the system.I recommend this organisation and its people very strongly.

We are very happy with AG Solar. They were quick to respond to the request for a quote and kept us informed the whole way through. We got a great quality 10.125kw system with SunPower panels and Fronius inverter. The install was quick, on time and the guys were very tidy. The black panels look great too!

AG Solar have just installed a Sunpower solar system and Fronius EV charger. The whole experience has been flawless, from a very reasonable and very clear quote and explanation, to a prompt and pain-free installation and now a great, well functioning system with easy remote control and monitoring. Only too happy to recommend highly. Great team, professional and courteous.
Great service and product. Fitted a 6.6kw System and storage battery. The whole experience was seamless and operating perfectly. Highly recommend this Company

AG Solar made the process of getting solar installed a breeze from being to end.  Their quote was easy to understand, they followed it up, they came and checked out what was a tricky site and they installed as promised on the date we set.  Other solar providers found the site too difficult and basically gave up.  That included some large electricity providers.  I can't recommend them highly enough.

Very happy with end to end process from initial sales inquiry through to installation and after completion with no issues experienced at all. Also after sales customer service has been very proactive and responsive. I highly recommend AGSilar
Great customer service and communication, installation was easy as, highly recommended

I was referred to AG Solar by a friend who had used them and from first contact the process was smooth and professional. We needed to make some changes to the original quote which was not a problem for AG Solar. The installers turned up when they said they would and worked to the time frame they advised. We had an issue after about 18 months that was resolved quicker than I expected so I am very happy with the product and service we received.

The sales/quoting process was good and was far better than the installation experience.The guys installing the panels did a pretty average job and that's being kind.  Issues were as follows:1-There wasn't room for the 20 panels that were quoted for on the west and east facing roof areas so they installed panel 20 facing south. This panel produces hardly any power and I would have preferred having the option of not installing it.2- The rails for the 3 panels on the garage roof was about 10 cm short. Installers added a short extension piece which distorted when the clamps for the solar panels were tightened which meant that the edge of the solar panel closest to the edge of the roof where the maximum wind load is was not attached at all.3- The panels weren't installed parallel to the roof. By this I mean that the panels were at different pitches which was very obvious from the street and looked awful. I pointed this out to the installers and I had to instruct them on how to fix this.4- only some of the rail end caps were installed. These are the ones I could see from the street I'm not sure about other locations.5- along the narrow section of roof the sparky decided to run conduit on top of the tiles and as such the conduit is in a place that is susceptible to damage.6 - 2 of the installers were wandering around without shirts on and looked very unprofessionalCommissioning of the Enphase Envoy unit was all good and everything is working ok.- After complaining to the company, he did send out 2 installers to replace the rails that were short. They didn't check any other parts of the installation though, even when I requested this.

We contacted AG Solar for an initial quote and was met with wonderful customer service and expertise.So we went ahead with them for the installation, which was very smooth and easy.They were happy to answer any questions we had, and we are super happy to recommend them as a solar installer.
AG solar gave me great advice in choosing a system that was right for our house, install day was smooth and fast and they promptly answered post install questions I had. Highly recommend!

I contacted AG Solar in July on the recommendation of my next-door-neighbour.  AG Solar use their own employees (not subcontractors) for the installation work, and that influenced my decision to go with them.We considered a few options before deciding on the micro inverters, with 10 panels on the North face, 12 on the South.Very pleased that the installation was completed in one day, despite a midday rain delay.Some hiccups with the 3-phase supply which shutdown the system for 3 days, but that has been the only problem so far, AG Solar’s response was immediate.AG Solar should be quite pleased with the way that their team work so conscientiously to achieve client satisfaction. I’m very impressed..

I sourced a number of quotes when I intended to get a Solar system, and I found AG Solar to be the most competitive and convenient as it was all done on-line.The installation was completed on time as agreed and the team of trades were very friendly, professional and polite. Any questions I had during the work was dealt with immediately and professionally.The area was left clean & tidy, and the system was fully operational at the end of the day.

After the initial installation of our Solar System the solar generation/outputs were not achieving the quoted/predicted performance.After raising these issues with AG Solar they investigated the issues with the Inverter Data, contacted the inverter manufacturer, undertook inverter resets and then attended site to trouble shoot the installation and fix the problems.Immediately after this site visit the solar generation/outputs drastically improved and all issues were sorted out.We felt that the after care service support could not have been any better and and we really appreciated the prompt response and rectifications.

Contact with the company was easy and quick. Customer service department was efficient in taking my enquiry, they had good product knowledge and the quotation was sent to me exactly when it was advised it would be available.I had a technical enquiry on the quote and I was put through to one of the company directors who answered my question immediately.My emails were answered on the day I sent them. When I placed the order it was Confirmed and an installation date booked.The installation was carried out in one day, with the crew being very efficient, making an extra effort to ensure the components were hidden from view, wherever possible, which was greatly appreciated. The site was left as they had found it with all rubbish and packaging removed at the end of the day. The crew were all very friendly and knew their jobs.All of the connection details were followed up and all necessary information and connections were made as promised.We are very happy with the system recommended, the supply and installation and the benefits already received.

The whole process from initial quotation to handover was completely seamless, AG Solar has got it down to a fine art. I was provided with a very clear and detailed quote. The power production that was quoted is very close to what I have been receiving these past few months.The boys turned up on the agreed day and completed all works before the end of the day including leaving the place the way they found it.All the electrical cabling was concealed as much as possible and the surface mounted ducting near the inverter was a clean tidy job as well.Although I could have bought a cheaper system, you do get what you pay for. When I had a few minor teething issues, there was someone at the other end to solve the problem. I was sent an electrician and after a software update carried out by Fronius, the problem was solved.AG Solar also completed all the necessary paperwork with my service provider.I'd have no hesitation recommending AG Solar to anyone interested in having a solar system installed on their roof.

From obtaining an initial quote, responding to queries and completing the installation, they were professional, responsive every step of the way. We are very impressed with the quality of the install. Wouldn’t hesitate to recommend AG Solar.

AG Solar were amazing from start to finish.  Firstly they were the only company who actually got on my roof to quote, which meant they were able to come up with a much better layout for the panels. The installers were on time and absolutely lovely to deal with. Any questions I have had since installed have been answered and I wasn't made to feel like I was putting anyone out by contacting them. They were so good my parents ended up using them a couple of weeks later and also had a great experience.

Our old solar system was 15 years old and performing well below its rated energy production.  After shopping around we selected AG Solar on price, customer service and we liked to support a local company wherever possible.  The new system was installed on the schedule date, the technicians worked professionally and cleaned up on completion.  Before leaving I was shown how to install the iSolarCloud app on my phone and complete the Bluetooth link to my new inverter.With the high cost of electricity and the low feed-in solar tariff on offer it's important use the energy as it's being produced as much as possible. Following the first month analysing the performance data on the iSolarCloud app and consumption on our energy providers app we have now changed how and when we use our more energy hungry appliances to reduce our monthly bill.I would also add the follow up call from AG Solar technical support checking on how the system was running and the bluetooth connectivity was very reassuring.
Pleasure to deal with. From start to finish. AG solar able to squeeze the install in very quick and the install team was no worries. Recommend for sure.

Great local supplier. Their advice and installation schedules can be trusted.The installers were great on the day. They put in extra effort to ensure a quality install, including offering to mount the inverter in a more protected space and installing wiring through existing ducts, despite it being more work for them.System has been working flawlessly since.

AG Solar quoted on my rooftop solar system. They drafted the solar cell array with a best fit to current trees and the shape of the roof.  They were polite and professional.On installation, their staff delivered and installed the solar cells and the inverter on the day and the time that they stated. They were polite, and cleaned up after themselves removing any packaging from the cells or the inverter.Their user support was friendly and capable. They helped organise the grid connection, and showed me how to handle the information available from the system.The current system powers the daily power needs of two households from the one installation.My only complaint is that I didn't do this sooner.

Ag Solar have been very professional, ethical, helpful and friendly throughout the whole process, from my request for a quote to post installation. There was a minor difference between panel layout plan and the actual installation, but AG Solar confirmed in writing that there would be no less output and their guaranteed overall system performance still applied.The fact that they are a longstanding reputable local operation, who (alone among the 4 quotes I received) provided their company’s warranty not only for the installation, but also for the overall operation and performance of the Whole PV system including workmanship and products for 15 years. So far post installation, I have not had any problems and therefore no reason to contact them, which is exactly what I want and expect.With regard to actual system performance, as yet, there has been insufficient time, since installation, to fully access system performance. However to-date there have been no problems whatsoever with hardware or software and particularly given their performance warranty, I have no concerns in that regard. I highly recommend AG Solar.

The whole process from start to finish was very simple with the team from AG Solar. This started with the initial quote, responding to queries, providing info for installation, the installation itself and post implementation support. The whole team was responsive and professional and alleviated any questions we had. No doubt we will continue to use AG Solar for any future solar upgrades or installs and will always recommend to friends and family.

AG were a recommended tenderer from Solarquotes and their quote was quick, comprehensive and whilst not the cheapest I thought was the best value as I wanted a micro inverter system due to my roof configuration. My questions were quickly followed up and the quote was amended satisfactorily.Install was professional despite wet weather challengesThe system was up and running immediately after install and has performed to expectations since; no defects to date

Initially we were given so much conflicting advice that it made us indecisive, to the point where we did nothing. We would repeatedly search for an installer, then lose interest. Over and over, again and again as we read their reviews.Then we looked at AGSolar. Their 5x Star rating caught our attention. Especially given that the review base was so massive. Both on SolarQuotes reviews and Google reviews. As I read through the individual reviews, I knew that this would be the company to install our Solar System.Initially we dealt mainly with Trent Amber, who is the Director. He was very patient as he led us through the minefield that is Solar Renewable Energy. We immediately felt comfortable and decided to go with his Company.Once we decided on a system Trent had Zac and his boys install a 16.2kw solar system with 40x 405w SunPower solar panels, 1x SunPower & 1x Fronius Inverter, 2x 10.1kwh SunPower batteries.The transition across to Solar went through without a hitch. No complications at all. Ben has been a great help leading up to the install and has provided great after sales support as well. Together they all did such a great job.The black solar panels and the the black rails that they sit on, really make our house look better. They are aligned so straight that they appear to be as one very sleek unit. It’s been 6 months now and the electricity cost is no longer a concern to us.The guys were all so professional and friendly. It was a pleasure to have them at our place during the installation.A special thanks to Chloe and Amanda as well.Leo & Nancy.

My AG Solar system meets all expectations. The controller app facilitates me to stagger my household consumption so as to optimise the use of solar electricity, including charging my electric vehicle using only excess solar electricity that would otherwise be sent to the grid. Customer service was prompt and excellent in following up a couple of minor issues that arose.
The team from AG solar were professional and good to deal with. There were some initial teething issues but they worked hard until all issues were resolved.

AG Solar provided an outstanding experience for our solar system installation. From the initial consultation to the final setup, the team was punctual, friendly, and highly efficient. They offered multiple design options tailored to our needs, allowing us to choose high-quality components, including SunPower panels and a Fronius inverter.The installation was seamless, with attention to detail ensuring no visible conduits. Their customer service was exceptional, with prompt responses to all our inquiries. Although not the cheapest option, the investment in quality was evident, and we are thrilled with the results. Highly recommended! .

We recently had AG Solar install a Sunpower system with battery, and the entire experience was excellent. The quotation process was easy and transparent, with the team being reactive, helpful, and professional throughout. Installation was painless, and any post-installation issues, such as a software glitch that we experienced, were quickly and efficiently resolved without fuss. Highly recommend AG Solar for their outstanding service and support.

AG Solar was professional throughout our quoting and installation process. They answered our questions and made alterations to our rooftop plan during the quote stage as requested, with no problems. Installation itself was smooth, a little delayed initially due to bad weather holding up their jobs, but very prompt, tidy and professional once they arrived. All in all the process was straightforward and we would recommend AG Solar to prospective customers. Solar panels are working well. They were a local company to us, which we appreciate in terms of potential for follow-up or any future concerns.

AG Solar made the whole process nice and easy. We had 8 other companies quote on the job and only 2 companies would even consider the job, this being because of the steep pitch of our roof.We picked AG Solar because their quote and sales staff were both well presented, comprehensive and left us with no questions regarding the whole process.The sales staff were very knowledgeable and there was no deviation from the quoted amount.The installers were great, it was good to see them take their time to work out a safe action plan to tackling the steep pitch of the roof to keep everyone safe. Install was very tidy and looks fantastic. Once again post installation they left us with no questions on how the system worked and gave us a thorough rundown on the operation on the solar system and accompanying apps.No complaints, I would defiantly recommend the AG Solar team.

How was the sales/quoting process? Great! Competitive and fair price negotiation, approachable, helpful and  understandingHow did the installation go? Due to circumstances outside AG's control they were required to use a 3rd party installer. the business owner was reassuring and took carriage of any coordination. The contractor was professional and punctual, responsive and completed the job over a 2 day install period due to bad weatherHow was the customer service? Amazing, from sales to after installation support AG have knocked it out of the park. They took end to end ownership for the process and live up to their well-deserved reputation as one of Sydney's top tier installers
Pre during and post have all been brilliant. We recommend AG solar to everyone

The AG Solar installation process was great, delivered what was quoted and promised. On time, with their own employees (no contractors) and all to spec no issues. Very easy and pleasing to deal with. Highly recommend the team! Thanks

AG Solar delivered a top shelf solar system to our home in Caringbah.They provided 4 quotes based on our requirements: one based on a smaller system, another based on a slightly larger system. They also provided quotes based on payment in full or on a finance plan.Both were very detailed with explanations on the benefits and analysis for each system.I asked Daniel probably 20 questions and he was extremely helpful with his answers and recommendations.Customer service was brilliant, installers punctual and very pro-active with their suggestion to slightly change the orientation of 2 panels.I would recommend AG Solar to anyone thinking of putting solar panels on their roof.

Thorough research led me to choose Sunpower panels and also to choose their local supplier AG SolarI wanted a local supplier in case of issues post installation and I wanted that local supplier to at least give me the confidence that they would be around in the future., Reviews of AG Solar, their website, and their professional quote gave me the confidence to go with them.  I should note they were not the cheapest nor the most expensive quote.Unlike some of the companies I sought quotes from, AG Solar did not hound me, and indeed it was several months before I decided to proceed.Once I decided to proceed I was given an install date which they stuck to, their installation crew introduced themselves and were friendly and professional.I was given instruction and manuals and also advice on how to organise the associated grid connection which was complicated as I needed to upgrade my meter.  They also followed this with a call to make sure I was happy with the process etc.Was I happy with AG Solar, yes and I have since recommended them to all my friends when they have indicated they are looking at solar.
Very happy with the install and service from the team at AG Solar. Would happily recommend.

Sales & quotation process was relatively painless. Discussed the options and came up with a solution that matched our requirements ensuring we also didn't over-spec. Once things progressed, we received timely updates as to the installation and when the install team came out on-site they were great. Polite, clean, efficient and explained the installation process and system in detail.

We undertook a new build and had AG Solar quote before construction began. They worked in with our builder to have our 9kw installed with no fuss or add stress for him. They came back and commissioned when was agreed and kept us in the loop through the entire process. Highly recommend

Can’t recommend AG Solar enough. Experienced and skilled team with the added benefit of a leadership team that cares about its customers and the quality of installs.Have had my solar panels and system for over a year - it’s been faultless and made a huge positive difference to me energy bills (when it’s not raining in Sydney !!).

Fantastic and seamless. Completely thorough and addressed all questions and ensured we understood. Fantastic team honestly, compared to some other companies I encountered.Install was seamless. Booked in and arrived promptly on the day. The install team were just as fabulous as the office team. Polite, clean and thorough. Wouldn’t even knew they were there and extremely helpful. Customer service was 10/10 - solar was new to us and ag solar were beyond helpful to organise everything and ran us through how everything worked including their fantastic app!

We had AG Solar install a brand new system on our roof. They recommended high quality products and were out to install them super quick. It's been over a year now and we've saved so much on our electricity bills

From start to finish the overall experience was excellent .We found AG solar very competitive and communicated well throughout the whole process .The install went smoothly and the job site was cleaned and well organised . In particular the installation team were fantastic .
